title: Great tour guide
text: We had a very enthusiastic and knowledgeable tour guide! Great experience! We all enjoyed the tour! I would highly recommend it!
author: karensZ537JQ

title: The best tour guide in Barcelona!
text: We had a tour yesterday with Roberto and he was amazing! So invested in what he was saying, passionate and comical! I highly recommend everyone goes via Roberto at Mon Gaudi as you will have such a great time. Thank you so much!
author: N349KJannieh

title: A visit you don't forget
text: Robert's guided tour was great. He has conveyed his passion for the Holy Family and for Gaudí, It has been a total success. Lights and shadows of Gaudi. Highly recommended!!
author: Flyer817205
